sentences.en: Three young children made racially abusive comments to the mother of a Bournemouth shop owner.

sentences.en: Clause 40 is modeled on the existing law on racially aggravated offenses.

sentences.en: Mitigating Terry Holder said this was the first time Barden had racially abused anyone and there was no suggestion the abuse had become physical.

sentences.en: In the context of racially segregated America, the play looks inwards to explore the pressures upon family unity.
